measured: Measured from the real index {index} with pageinspect: {rows} rows, {height} levels, {pages} pages (metapage included).
estimated: Estimate by formula for {rows} rows, extrapolated from a real sample of {fromRows} rows of index {index}: {height} levels. Not a measurement.
countFailed: Cannot measure: the row count of the table could not be read. Not simulated.
empty: Cannot measure: the table is empty, so the index has no leaf pages to measure. Not simulated.
mustMeasure: Cannot estimate: up to 500,000 rows must be measured on real data, not extrapolated. Not simulated.
tooLarge: Cannot estimate: more than 1 billion rows is beyond the formula's range. Not simulated.
noFanout: Cannot estimate: the sample has no valid leaf width. Not simulated.
noInternalFanout: Cannot estimate: the sample tree has no internal page yet, so the node width above the leaves is unknown. Use a larger sample. Not simulated.
